direccion.name: Management
direccion.description: Team responsible for strategic decision-making, planning, and general oversight of VRTon operations.

desarrollo.name: Development
desarrollo.description: Responsible for creating websites, applications, bots, and other tools used by VRTon.

audiovisuales.name: Audiovisuals
audiovisuales.description: The creative team uses audiovisual design to create multimedia content that effectively communicates our social mission.

2d.name: 2D Design
2d.description: Our creative team uses 2D design to create interfaces, characters, environments, and visual elements that effectively communicate our social mission.

3d.name: 3D Design
3d.description: Our creative team uses 3D design to create models, characters, and environments that effectively communicate our social mission.

marketing.name: Marketing & Communication
marketing.description: The team responsible for spreading our mission, managing our social networks, and creating communication strategies that amplify the impact of our social projects.

mapmaking.name: Map Making
mapmaking.description: The creators of our virtual worlds. This team is responsible for designing and building maps and environments on VR platforms, creating immersive experiences for our social causes.

eventos.name: Host & Activities
eventos.description: The architects of our virtual experiences. This team designs, organizes, and executes events, shows, and interactive experiences that connect our community.

dj.name: DJs & Shows
dj.description: The artists who bring music and spectacle to our virtual experiences. This team is responsible for creating musical events and live shows that entertain and connect our community.

moderacion.name: Moderation
moderacion.description: The guardians of our virtual spaces. This team maintains a safe and positive environment on our platforms, ensuring everyone can participate comfortably in our charitable activities.

translation.name: Translation
translation.description: The team responsible for translating and adapting our content to different languages and cultures, ensuring our message reaches a global audience.
